Oscillatory residual after subtracting the specparam aperiodic component, in two
conventions, **loaded from the DuckDB feature store** (`00_specparam_features.qmd`
must be rendered first) — no refitting here. The store is keyed by a hash of the
`pesco.config` settings, so these curves are guaranteed to come from the current
canonical fit.

- **log (flattened)** — $L_{\mathrm{osc}}(f) = \log_{10}\mathrm{PSD}(f) -
  L_{\mathrm{ap}}(f)$.
- **linear (normalised)** — $\mathrm{PSD}_{\mathrm{osc}}(f) =
  (\mathrm{PSD}(f) - \mathrm{PSD}_{\mathrm{ap}}(f)) / \sum_f \mathrm{PSD}(f)$.

Note (per @castanheira2025QuantifyingRhythmicArrhythmic): these *detrended*
residuals conflate the rhythmic and aperiodic components and are shown here for
visualisation / cross-modal overlap, **not** as the primary rhythmic-power
estimate — for that use the modelled specparam peak power (`peaks.PW`).

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_grid,
    geom_hline,
    geom_line,
    geom_vline,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_manual,
    scale_x_log10,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco import config, store
from pesco.experimental.clustering import band_edges
from pesco.bandpower import LOBE_COLORS

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DB_PATH = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/analysis.duckdb"
fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

LOBE_ORDER = ["Occipital", "Parietal", "Frontal", "Temporal", "Insula"]
RESID_LABELS = {
    "log": "log  (L_osc = log10 PSD / PSD_ap)",
    "linear": "linear  ((PSD − PSD_ap) / ΣPSD)",
}
PARAMS_HASH = store.params_hash(
    config.SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, config.FREQ_RANGE, config.SELECTED_MODE
)
```

```{python}
#| label: load
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
features = store.load(con, "features", PARAMS_HASH)
channels = store.load(con, "channels", PARAMS_HASH)[["channel", "dataset", "Lobe"]]
con.close()

feat = features.merge(channels, on=["channel", "dataset"], how="left")
feat["psd"] = 10.0 ** feat["log_psd"]
feat["psd_ap"] = 10.0 ** feat["ap_log"]
feat["log"] = feat["log_psd"] - feat["ap_log"]
total = feat.groupby(["dataset", "channel"])["psd"].transform("sum")
feat["linear"] = (feat["psd"] - feat["psd_ap"]) / total
```

```{python}
#| label: aggregate
def lobe_mean(feat, residual_type):
    g = (
        feat.groupby(["dataset", "Lobe", "freq"], observed=True)[residual_type]
        .mean()
        .reset_index(name="value")
    )
    g["residual_type"] = RESID_LABELS[residual_type]
    return g


residual_curves = pd.concat(
    [lobe_mean(feat, "log"), lobe_mean(feat, "linear")], ignore_index=True
)
residual_curves["Lobe"] = pd.Categorical(
    residual_curves["Lobe"], categories=LOBE_ORDER, ordered=True
)
residual_curves["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
    residual_curves["dataset"], categories=config.DATASETS, ordered=True
)
```

## Per-lobe mean oscillatory residual

```{python}
#| label: fig-residual-spectra
#| output: true
residual_fig = (
    ggplot(residual_curves, aes("freq", "value", color="Lobe"))
    + geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#bbbbbb", size=0.4)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=band_edges(), linetype="dashed", color="#e6e6e6", size=0.25)
    + geom_line(size=0.8)
    + facet_grid("residual_type ~ dataset", scales="free_y")
    + scale_color_manual(values=LOBE_COLORS, name="lobe")
    + scale_x_log10(breaks=[1, 4, 8, 13, 30, 80])
    + labs(
        x="frequency (Hz)",
        y="oscillatory residual",
        title="Oscillatory residual after aperiodic removal (per-lobe mean)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(11, 7), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    residual_fig.save(
        fig_dir / f"aperiodic_residual_spectra.{ext}",
        width=11, height=7, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
residual_fig
```
